comparisonPolicy: Match pose, resolution and display for quantitative comparisons. Historical 35-degree targets remain visual context, never numerical truth for the new sunlight.

iterationNotes.000_baseline: Preserved original; CPU measurement unavailable (inactive entry point). See 005 for original CPU measurement.
iterationNotes.001_calibrated_current: Rejected diagnostic: paused city did not refresh shadow/light uniforms.
iterationNotes.002_paused_lighting_fixed: Paused visual updates corrected; original shadow filtering.
iterationNotes.003_finite_current: Finite sunlight filtering; Current mode diagnostic, no baked indirect.
iterationNotes.005_original_replay_streamed: Frozen original source and bake replay, with corrected CPU measurement.
iterationNotes.006_calibrated_baked: Rejected: bus bypassed exposure in the direct display path; Current switch did not complete.
iterationNotes.007_calibrated_bus_preserved: Rejected despite the provisional name: narrowing the sky hook did not fix the bus display defect; Current switch did not complete.
iterationNotes.008_display_and_current_restore: Bus display transform corrected; five poses and all reflection/mode transitions passed. First Current/Auto switches still require substantial preparation.
iterationNotes.009_calibrated_current: Current mode with calibrated diffuse sky independent of reflection strength; all five poses.
iterationNotes.010_calibrated_baked_4k: UHD before authored-UV bake correction; mode responsiveness was not measured.
iterationNotes.011_authored_uv_bake: Corrected bake and images; rejected for publication after discovering 23–24 second main-thread stalls on full lighting mode changes.
iterationNotes.012_shader_preparation: City shaders prepare before the view changes. Current max frame gap 0.571s; Auto 0.934s; Auto to Baked 0.036s. Reflection controls remain responsive, with zero world dropouts.
iterationNotes.013_raw_texture_bake: Corrected raw color, normal and alpha inputs in the bake compiler; new indirect transport. Calibrated light and exposure unchanged.
iterationNotes.014_installed_4k: Actual installed calibrated packages; no candidate index routing. Final UHD and two rounds of full-mode transition verification.

limits: Display error is diagnostic, not a photorealism score. Fake room interiors, Phong versus Principled BRDF, screen-space effects and shadow reconstruction remain different representations. Generated evidence stays untracked.
